We introduce WORTH, a novel, large-scale, and real-time urban tagging system that leverages a massive dataset of user-generated content from social media platforms. By utilizing a combination of machine learning and human feedback, WORTH can automatically identify and categorize urban features such as buildings, streets, and landmarks. Our approach is based on a two-stage process, where we first employ a deep learning model to generate a list of potential tags for each image, and then use a human-in-the-loop system to refine the results. Our evaluation shows that WORTH achieves a high level of accuracy, with an average F1 score of 0.83, and can process a large volume of images in real-time.
